questions.q: What are the two core jobs an Azure subscription performs?
options: A single login credential shared by a whole company
A naming convention enforced by the Azure Portal
A storage location for virtual machine disks only
A billing boundary and a scope for RBAC and policy assignments
questions.explain: A subscription rolls up costs into one invoice (billing boundary) and is also the level at which RBAC roles and Azure Policy automatically apply to everything inside it (scope).

questions.q: Which Azure CLI command lists every subscription your signed-in account can access?
options: az account management-group list
az account list
az group list
az account show
questions.explain: az account list shows every subscription available to your account; az account show only prints the one currently active.

questions.q: Why would an organization with many subscriptions create a management group instead of assigning the same RBAC role to each subscription individually?
options: Management groups replace the need for a Microsoft Entra tenant
RBAC roles cannot be assigned directly to a subscription at all
Assigning the role once at the management group level applies it to every subscription nested underneath automatically
Management groups are required before any subscription can be created
questions.explain: Management groups sit above subscriptions in the hierarchy specifically so RBAC and policy can be assigned once and inherited by every subscription nested below.

questions.q: What is the Tenant Root Group?
options: A special subscription reserved for billing administrators
A deprecated feature replaced by management groups
The resource group that stores Microsoft Entra directory data
The default top-level management group that automatically contains every management group and subscription in a tenant
questions.explain: Every Microsoft Entra tenant has one default Tenant Root Group at the very top of the management group hierarchy.

questions.q: In the Azure resource hierarchy, what level sits directly below subscriptions?
options: The Microsoft Entra tenant
Individual virtual machines only
Resource groups
Management groups
questions.explain: The hierarchy flows tenant, management groups, subscriptions, then resource groups, then the individual resources inside those resource groups.
